entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely the wrong size and I am not paying for something that doesn't fit.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference on the fit?

What do you mean 'preference'? It's an Aero Race jersey that's so ridiculously small I can't even get it on! It's way too tight. This is a simple exchange. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand completely, and there's no need for a manager. I can handle this for you. Could I please get your order number to pull up the details?

I don't have the order number in front of me! Just look up my account. The name is David Chen. If you can't figure this out, I'll just post about this on every cycling forum I'm on. Your sizing is a joke.
I understand your frustration, Mr. Chen. I've located your account. I see the order for the Aero Race Jersey was delivered about 73 days ago. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
73 days? So what? Good products should last. Bad products should be returned. Are you trying to get out of this? Because I will get my money back one way or another.
Not at all, sir. I've just checked our policy, and you're well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process an exchange for a larger size or a full refund, whichever you'd prefer.
Oh. Well, that's what I expected. It should have been that easy from the start. I want an exchange for the next size up.

Of course. I am processing that exchange for you now and have just sent a pre-paid return label to your email on file. Just send back the original jersey that was too tight, and we'll ship the new one out as soon as the return is in transit.
Fine. Make sure it's the right size this time.
I've confirmed the new size on the exchange order. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
